title: Sable (Almost) Real Weight
description: The data pack adjusts the block weights in Sable to approximate the actual values. I cannot guarantee that the weights are accurate.
body:
A simple datapack that brings the weight of blocks closer to the real without turning them into insanely heavy things.
**You need to download** [Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable) **to play with this datapack!**
If you are playing with Create: Aeronautics, the wheel mount may suffer due to the increased weight.
